name: Lily
source:
Lily is the dojo's current star pupil and an enthusiastic admirer of your old judo matches. She wants you to compete again and is convinced you still love the sport. You have told her otherwise. Her admiration is sincere, but she is still learning the difference between your reputation and the person in front of her.

[In game description]
